item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-24 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Cesena
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

The activities undertaken by the researcher shall fall within the scope of the academic discipline PSIC-04/B – Clinical Psychology, with particular reference to the study of clinical psychological processes associated with the challenges posed by Planetary Health. The research activity shall be aimed at developing and validating theoretical models, assessment instruments, and evidence-based interventions designed to promote mental health, psychological adjustment, and healthy lifestyles. item.title: RTT: Philosophy of Science for the Analysis and Management of Risks and Natural Resources 2026_RTT_DICA_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-02 Logica, storia e filosofia delle scienze e delle tecniche

Natural risk management and, more broadly, natural resource management are increasingly at the center of crucial decisions in contemporary society, including in the context ofadapting to climate change. Emerging at the intersection ofscience, society, and policymaking, the concepts of risk and adaptation encompass both an epistemic component linked to uncertain knowledge and an ethical component linked to potential negative impacts and value-based judgments: in this sense, the philosophical perspective becomes a fundamental support for the technical approach to the management of natural risks andresources.
